subject: Encryption evidence: audit bundle index + transit validation request
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@brightbank.com>

Cc: security_audits@brightbank.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Encryption artefacts for upcoming SOC2 appraisal (request)

Hi Aisha,

Quick one from BrightBank's audit team — our SOC2 assessor asked us to provide a compact index of all encryption-related artefacts for Redwood's tenant environment used by BrightBank. Specifically they want: 1) an inventory spreadsheet listing KMS keys (logical ids only), HSM attestation references, and where keys are used (at-rest vs transit); 2) a time-ordered snapshot of recent KEK/DEK rotations covering the last 12 months; and 3) representative HSM session logs for the most recent key ceremony window.

Can Redwood deliver a single audit bundle index + pointers (Drive link + file attachments) we can hand to the assessor by Friday, 2026-08-21? Also note we will need redaction of tenant identifiers and any customer-specific secrets. If you prefer, we can accept an index plus a gated link to the logs.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sam Patel
Senior IT Audit Manager
BrightBank

--
Reply to: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption artefacts for upcoming SOC2 appraisal (request)

Sam — thanks for the clear ask. We can produce the index and deliver a redacted bundle with gated access. Plan:
- I will assemble the audit-bundle-index.xlsx that lists logical key ids, key purpose (DEK/KEK), creation & rotation timestamps, HSM attestation reference id (sha256), and usage plane (at-rest/in-transit).
- Marissa & Irene: can you prepare a 12-month rotation timeline (kek-rotation-timestamps.csv) and pull a representative HSM session log bundle (hsm-session-log-20260812.txt) with tenant identifiers redacted?
- We'll upload everything to a secured Drive folder and provide a single CAIQ/SOC2 mapping PDF (caIQ-mapping-draft.pdf) that maps each artefact to SOC2 control IDs.

Target: initial package to BrightBank by EOD Thursday 2026-08-20 so you have time to forward to the assessor. If you need anything earlier (eg an interim index) say the word.

Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Aisha / Irene — picking this up. Quick notes from infra side:
- I will generate kek-rotation-timestamps.csv from our key-rotation service: columns will be logical_key_id, rotation_epoch, rotated_by, rotation_reason, verification_hash. No tenant secrets will be included.
- For HSM session logs: we'll extract session metadata and operation summaries rather than full verbose logs to avoid including sensitive payloads. The representative file will include timestamps, HSM slot id, operator id (redacted), operation type (wrap/unwrap/sign), and attestation reference. Example row: 2026-06-12T02:14Z | slot-3 | <redacted-op> | wrap | attestation:sha256:7f3b...
- I'll also include a short README in the bundle that explains obfuscation rules and the canonical mapping to SOC2 control categories.

Question for Aisha: BrightBank asked for "redaction of tenant identifiers" — confirm if we should remove all tenant_id columns or pseudonymize (eg tenant_001). BrightBank typically prefers pseudonymization with an appendix that maps pseudonyms to actual tenants under a separate NDA — do we want to offer that?

Will attach preliminary files by EOD Wednesday.

Marissa Cole
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
